prompt: Inside a vibrant flower shop, shelves are lined with colorful blooms. In the center foreground, a florist in a green apron wraps a bouquet of red roses in brown paper, handing it to a customer in a beige trench coat standing on the right. The customer reaches out with both hands to receive the flowers. To the left, a large ceramic vase filled with sunflowers sits on a wooden counter. A tabby cat sleeps on a stack of gardening magazines near the vase. In the background, a young assistant in a white shirt waters potted ferns on a high shelf using a copper watering can. Hanging baskets of purple petunias suspend from the ceiling above the counter. A glass display case in the lower right contains delicate orchids. A price tag holder stands empty on the counter near the florist's elbow. Sunlight streams through the front window, illuminating dust particles and creating bright highlights on the glossy leaves. The lighting is natural and bright, enhancing the vivid colors of the petals. The style is a photorealistic photo.
